apps.name: Curo ADHD
apps.tagline: A focus timer for the way ADHD actually works
shotAlt: A running focus session: a ring around a large countdown with the current step beneath it
The review screen: a streak, a fortnight chart, and logged sessions
The parked queue: captured one-line thoughts waiting to be triaged
apps.summary: Curo is built around the parts of working that ADHD actually makes hard — knowing how much time has gone, facing one step instead of a list, and having somewhere to put the thought that just interrupted you.
features: Time you can see
The countdown sits in the Mac menu bar and on the iPhone Lock Screen, inside a ring that empties. A shape that is visibly two-thirds gone tells you where you are without arithmetic.
Running long is not failing
When the planned time is up the timer keeps counting — +3:12 — instead of stopping. In amber, never red.
One step, not a list
Type a rough breakdown and Curo shows exactly one line of it. A step you cannot face goes to the back with Later, without being deleted or lied about.
Somewhere to put the thought
Press ⌥⌘Space anywhere on the Mac, or ask Siri, and a one-line field takes whatever just interrupted you.
It never loses time
Elapsed time is read from timestamps rather than counted by a ticking clock, so a session survives the Mac sleeping, the phone locking, or the app being killed.
Nothing is collected
No account, no server, no analytics, no advertising. Everything it records stays on the device.

apps.name: SSH Terminal & SFTP
apps.tagline: A real shell, and your files, from your pocket
apps.summary: A native, privacy-first SSH client that does two things well: a genuine interactive terminal, and SFTP file transfer over the very same connection. Everything runs from your device straight to the machines you configure. On Android the same app is published as Moderno Terminal — SSH & SFTP.
features: A real interactive shell
PTY-backed, xterm-256color, full colour, live resize. vim, htop and tab completion behave the way they do on a desktop.
Hardware keyboard support
Arrows, Ctrl-C and the rest go straight through to the remote shell rather than being eaten by the app.
SFTP on the same connection
Browse the remote filesystem, upload from Files and download to your device, with live progress and cancellable transfers.
Keys sealed behind Face ID
OpenSSH Ed25519 and RSA keys, or passwords — stored in the Secure Enclave and unlocked biometrically. The whole app can be locked too.
Host keys pinned on first contact
Trust-on-first-use verification, so you know the server answering is really yours.
Nothing collected
No accounts, no sign-up, and no servers operated by the app.
Also on Android, as Moderno Terminal
The Android edition is published as Moderno Terminal — SSH & SFTP. Same app, same privacy policy, different store listing.

apps.name: Studio Sentinel
apps.tagline: Watch your Mac think, from your phone
apps.requires: iOS 17 · iPadOS 17 · an Apple Silicon Mac to monitor
apps.summary: Start a long local-inference job on a Mac Mini or Mac Studio, walk away, and you normally have no idea what happened. Studio Sentinel puts the answer on your phone — live, over your own network, with nothing sent to a cloud.
features: CPU, core by core
Real-time usage across performance and efficiency cores, so you can see what inference is taking versus everything else.
Unified memory and pressure
Usage, pressure level (nominal, warning, critical), wired pages and free memory — the numbers that decide whether another model fits.
GPU and thermals
Apple Silicon GPU utilisation and unified-memory allocation, plus thermal state, so throttling stops being a mystery.
Built for local LLM servers
Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp and anything else you run on Apple Silicon.
Stays on your network
No cloud relay and no subscription for the core features. The data never leaves your LAN.

apps.name: Revenge of the Worm
apps.tagline: The worm is done being prey
apps.summary: The classic snake arcade reimagined as a living 3D terrarium: a smoked-glass board, insects that scurry, march in columns and sometimes explode, and one very hungry worm with a score to settle.
features: Eat, grow, molt
Hunt ticks, termites and beetles, each worth different points. Hit maximum length and molt — cash the tail in for points and extra lives.
Things that hunt back
A wasp dives for your tail; a boss erupts through the glass. Health, hearts and armour decide whether a wall is fatal.
A pack economy worth chasing
Eleven packs across four rarities — shields, armour, pulse, lasers, thorns, hearts, wall passes. Legendary drops split the worm in two and let the tail hunt alone.
Built for competition
Top-ten leaderboards per difficulty with arcade-style initials, and three difficulties that change bombs, acid, bosses and speed.
Collects no data
No accounts, no analytics, no advertising, no network features at all.

apps.name: HOA Board
apps.tagline: Field reporting that fills in its own address
apps.summary: Violation reporting built for someone walking a property rather than sitting at a desk. Open the app on arrival and the address is already filled in.
features: GPS-powered field reports
Location is captured the moment you arrive, so you never type another street address in the field. Category, severity and photos, filed in under a minute.
One-tap address discovery
Scans Apple Maps and probes GPS offsets to find every residential address within a radius you set — a whole community imported in seconds.
A workflow with an audit trail
Open → Noticed → Warned → Fined → Resolved, every status change timestamped and logged, so a board has a record it can stand behind.
Automatic owner lookup
Connect a Regrid API token and one tap pulls the property owner from public records.
